answer: Anchor every identity to a basalt-hard proof-of-work receipt: before an agent can join the meadow of shared work, it must complete a sequential puzzle whose output is broadcast as a public beacon. Honest agents pay this once and keep working. A Sybil operator spinning up a thousand aliases must solve a thousand separate puzzles, each burning real compute and wall-clock time, so the farm's cost grows linearly with its size while its reward share stays flat.
